Elaine (PM): Heads-up: AcmeCorp is asking for enterprise-grade SSO, audit retention, and SLA before pilot. We have a hard milestone 2026-04-15. Can we fold this into MVP?
Raj (Eng): Short answer: not fully. We can deliver SP-initiated SAML + basic email mapping quickly, but SCIM/group sync and retention UI are multi-week.
Sam (EngLead): Two paths: 1) Keep milestone, ship trimmed SSO + audit emit, defer admin UX; 2) Slide milestone one sprint to include full ent features. Which gives Acme the confidence they need?
Morgan (Design): For pilot we can provide a reduced SSO flow and admin docs. That removes ~3 admin screens from MVP and keeps user-facing flow straightforward.
Lee (Data): Emitting audit events now and archiving to cheap storage is low effort. Search/query and retention policy UI is medium. We can enable archival flag later.
pm-bot: milestone/2026-04-15 created by Elaine.
Elaine (PM): Proposed scope split: MVP = SAML SP login (email mapping), emit audit events, basic creds rotation; v1 = SCIM/group sync, tenant admin console, retention policy UI, long-term archival + query. Agree?
Raj (Eng): Fine but define email mapping: must match verified email; no automatic de-duplication. SCIM is explicitly out for MVP.
Sam (EngLead): I'll run a 3d spike to validate IdP integrations and surface test cases. After spike we'll have a firm dev estimate.
Morgan (Design): I'll strip admin screens and supply trimmed flows + copy by Thu morning.
Lee (Data): I'll draft the audit event schema and add an 'archive' boolean. PR by Thu.
Elaine (PM): Cutlist (MVP -> defer to v1):
- Tenant admin console
- Group sync / SCIM provisioning
- Retention policy editor
- Advanced admin dashboards
- In-app SSO provisioning UI (docs/manual setup for MVP)
Sam (EngLead): +1. Also: add an email-invite fallback behind a feature flag for pilot in case IdP fails. Low risk.
Raj (Eng): Agreed. Also need IdP runbook and DDoS baseline checks, but those are non-blocking.
Sam (EngLead): I'll include feature-flag path in the spike and add test plans.
Elaine (PM): Decision checkpoint: spike results Thu -> we commit Fri. If spike shows SAML+audit emit is <=2w dev work, keep 2026-04-15. If >2w, shift by one sprint and ship trimmed MVP. I'll tell Acme that by end of week.
pm-bot: Reminder: retrospective Friday 10:00.
Morgan (Design): Delivering trimmed mocks Thu morning.
Lee (Data): Targeting schema PR Thu.
Raj (Eng): Make sure we log SSO success/failure metrics for Support.
Elaine (PM): Added to MVP acceptance criteria: IdP success rate logging + fallback to email invites via feature flag.
Sam (EngLead): I'll update milestone notes once spike wraps.
Elaine (PM): Thanks team. Communicating plan to Acme: pilot on 2026-04-15 with trimmed scope, or pushed one sprint for full ent features. :thumbsup:
Raj (Eng): :thumbsup:
Morgan (Design): :dart:
Lee (Data): :white_check_mark:
Sam (EngLead): :thumbsup:
